race.title: Hope House Children's Hospices Conditional Jockeys' Training Series Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Quite a difficult race to assess with MALINAS GLORY just about the most persuasive option on the back of a more encouraging effort back hurdling at Hereford with a good-value conditional also booked. Cahier's Den should run closer to form this time, with Eaststone Buck's another to consider on his reappearance. MALINAS GLORY (IRE) CAHIER'S DEN (IRE) EASTSTONE BUCK'S
